messages:
maria (partner-ops): Quick heads-up — vendor mini-sprint this week to lock H100/H200 + MI300/ Gaudi announce windows. Need to align SI image cuts, marketplace SKU tags, and press embargo windows. Can we do a 20m sync?
kevin (eng-plat): Yep. What's the objective scope? firmware fixes only or infra image QA too?
olivia (solutions): Recommend infra image QA + 1 last perf smoke (end-to-end with kv-cache). SI teams will need the golden image by Thu EOD.
lina (pm): Priority is: 1) marketplace tagging 2) SI image 3) press window. If we can compress, we want to push partner announcement into next sprint’s first week.
maria (partner-ops): Target timeline idea: cut SI images Wed morning, QA Wed afternoon, marketplace tags & docs Thu morning, announce window Fri. Thoughts?
sam (partner-eng): Risk: vendor firmware patch for H200 might land Wed night. If that happens we should gate SI image until Thu morning. Can we do a conditional cut?
kevin (eng-plat): Conditional cut makes sense. Plan: create image_tag = "candidate-v1" and a follow-up "golden-v1" if firmware patch lands. We can automate rebuild with a one-liner in the lab: 
```
./build_image.sh --gpu=h200,h100,gaudi --tag=candidate-v1
```
maria (partner-ops): love that. Lina, can you own marketplace tag naming convention so marketing and partner teams are aligned? e.g., redwood-gpu-h200-2026-04-candidate
lina (pm): on it. I'll add naming + SKU mapping to the doc and ping legal for embargo clearance.
olivia (solutions): SI teams — please reserve 2 hours Wed afternoon for smoke test signoff. I'll post matrix of tests (latency P50/P95, perf throughput, model load times).
vendor-bot: :mega: Vendor firmware patch 0.9.7 scheduled for 2026-04-08T22:00Z. ETA: 2 hours rollout.
sam (partner-eng): ok that's the wildcard. If 0.9.7 lands on time we still hit Wed->Thu flow; if delayed we slide everything 24h. I'll put an automated check on firmware tag and slack notify here.
kevin (eng-plat): devops note — we should snapshot current kernels and have rollback steps in the image build runbook. I'll add to runbook: 
- snapshot-kernels.sh 
- image-rebuild.sh --rollback <snapshot>
maria (partner-ops): action items: @lina marketplace naming + legal ping, @olivia test matrix, @kevin runbook kernel snapshot + conditional build script, @sam firmware watch + auto-notify. I'll schedule a 20m sync today 1600 PT.
olivia (solutions): question — do we want to include Gaudi in the first wave or keep it tier-2? Gaudi drivers have been flaky in last perf runs.
lina (pm): keep Gaudi tier-2 unless vendor confirms driver stabilization by Tue EOD. We should still prepare SKU tags but mark them "deferred" in marketplace.
sam (partner-eng): agreed. I'll ask vendor to confirm Gaudi driver test coverage and post results here.
maria (partner-ops): linking the working doc: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/mini-sprint-announce-window (please comment with blockers).
kevin (eng-plat): I'll queue CI job now and add conditional rebuild. 
kevin (eng-plat): ETA for first candidate images: Wed 10:30 PT.
olivia (solutions): noted, will align SI teams.
lina (pm): legal asked for embargo window proposal — propose Fri 2026-04-10 16:00-18:00 UTC. Thoughts?
maria (partner-ops): Sounds reasonable. If vendor patch hits late, we move to Sat same window. Add contingency to doc.
vendor-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder will post 12h before scheduled announce window.
kevin (eng-plat): small ask — can marketing get a perf summary (one slide) Tue EOD so they can prep assets if we confirm Fri? Olivia can you supply P50/P95 + throughput?
olivia (solutions): yes, I'll produce a one-slide perf snapshot from the smoke tests.
maria (partner-ops): ok all — syncing 1600 PT today. If vendor patch changes status we'll update thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
